title: Gymnopédie No. 1
description: Satie's slow, dreamlike waltz: a two-chord left-hand sway under a floating melody that hangs on long held notes. A favourite first 'real' classical piece because it sounds far harder than it is.

arrangements.label: Intermediate
arrangements.notes: The original opening section (introduction and the first two statements of the theme) with the authentic Gmaj7/Dmaj7 left-hand sway, closing on a D major chord instead of continuing into the development.
teachingPoints: Left hand alone first: low bass note on beat 1, then leap up to the three-note chord on beat 2 and hold it through beat 3.
Keep the chord leap quiet and even; the whole piece is one dynamic (soft) with a gentle lean on beat 1.
Right hand enters in bar 5: F#-A-G, F#-C#-B, C#-D-A, then a long F# held for five bars while the left hand keeps swaying.
Count the long held notes out loud (1-2-3 per bar) so the left hand stays strictly in time underneath.
